init_wandb_singleton: initialize a wandb singleton logger instance with config, run id, project, and entity
log_with_wandb_singleton: log a dictionary of metrics to wandb using the singleton logger with optional step and commit
log_table_wandb: log a wandb table with column names and row data using the singleton logger
log_artifact_wandb: log a file artifact to wandb with a name, type, and file location
log_tensor_stats: log tensor statistics like mean and std to wandb using the convenience log_stats function
